description: This Java source file defines the MidiScope class, which extends MidiDeviceService to implement a virtual MIDI device that logs MIDI messages using a ScopeLogger. It manages MIDI input receivers, handles device connection statuses, and processes incoming MIDI data.

classes.name: MidiScope
classes.description: A virtual MIDI device service that logs MIDI messages and device connection status.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending MidiReceiver that forwards received MIDI data to a MidiFramer.

methods.name: onGetInputPortReceivers
methods.description: Returns an array containing the MIDI input port receiver.

methods.name: setScopeLogger
methods.description: Sets the ScopeLogger instance and initializes the MidiFramer with a LoggingReceiver.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data and forwards it to the MidiFramer for processing.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Logs connection or disconnection events based on device status.
